reviewNotes: Twenty-five JojaMart shelf labels and package descriptions were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover food, cleaning, and hygiene terminology, parody brands and claims, intensity progression, punctuation, humor, and concise natural Romanian labels; both found no remaining objective issue.

JojaMart.79.source: Joja Oil -- A proprietary blend of delicious oils. Use it for any purpose.
JojaMart.79.translation: Ulei Joja -- Un amestec exclusiv de uleiuri delicioase. Folosește-l în orice scop.

JojaMart.80.source: Joja Multipurpose Detergent -- Use it for your laundry, for your dishes, to clean your hands, as a shampoo, and even as toothpaste! Mix it with JojaMeal to make a delicious icing.
JojaMart.80.translation: Detergent universal Joja -- Folosește-l pentru rufe, vase, spălarea mâinilor, ca șampon și chiar ca pastă de dinți! Amestecă-l cu JojaMeal pentru a obține o glazură delicioasă.

JojaMart.83.source: Disks and pucks of pure gluten.
JojaMart.83.translation: Discuri și pucuri de gluten pur.

JojaMart.86.source: Canned fish... now with teeth whitening sauce.
JojaMart.86.translation: Pește la conservă... acum cu sos pentru albirea dinților.

JojaMart.91.source: Laundry Detergent -- now with 10x the fragrance!
JojaMart.91.translation: Detergent de rufe -- acum cu un parfum de 10 ori mai puternic!
